title: A worker released after its ready-to-merge verdict is never re-judged as cancelled on resume
description: Follow-up from hol (#141, 2026-09-29): #141 gives a reported worker up to 10s to exit before Cancel records cancel.json. If the run releases a worker (after collecting ready-to-merge) that is still running past that window, the attempt is still recorded cancelled, and a restart re-reads it, finds 'cancelled' and rejects/redoes work the run already judged. Root fix: once the run has recorded an attempt's collect verdict in its own records, resume reads that verdict first and a later executor-side cancel (from the run's own release) cannot override it; a cancel only counts when it precedes the verdict.
acceptance_criteria: A test releases a worker that keeps running past the grace, restarts the run, and the attempt is integrated from its recorded verdict, not rejected as cancelled
